name: JA_CN_ACCOUNT_BALANCES
description: This table contains the beginning balance, period net debit amount, period net credit amount, and ending balance for natural account and subsidiary segments by period and currency.

columns.name: ACC_BAL_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies an accounting balance.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies a ledger.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies a legal entity.

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT
columns.description: Value for balancing segment of accounting flexfield.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting period for which the delta balances should be tracked.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the amounts in a record.

columns.name: COST_CENTER_SEGMENT
columns.description: Value for cost center segment of accounting flexfield.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source to indicate the type of third party. 'C' indicates customer and 'S' indicates supplier.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Third party identifier, such as customer identifier and supplier identifier.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of third party, such as customer number and supplier number.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies a project.

columns.name: PROJECT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the project in Oracle Projects to which the cost of this payment/shipment will be charged.

columns.name: PROJECT_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the project. When the project is defined as 'Chart of Account', the value is 'COA'. When the project is defined as 'project module', the value is 'PA'.

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT
columns.description: Value for natural account number of accounting flexfield.

columns.name: PERSONNEL_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies a personnel.

columns.name: PERSONNEL_NUMBER
columns.description: The employee number for employee supplier.

columns.name: BEGIN_BALANCE_DR_BEQ
columns.description: Beginning debit balance. It is specified in the base currency.

columns.name: BEGIN_BALANCE_CR_BEQ
columns.description: Beginning credit balance. It is specified in the base currency.

columns.name: BEGIN_BALANCE_DR
columns.description: Beginning debit balance summarized by itemization process.

columns.name: BEGIN_BALANCE_CR
columns.description: Beginning credit balances summarized by itemization process.

columns.name: PERIOD_NET_DR_BEQ
columns.description: Period net debit balance. It is specified in the base currency.

columns.name: PERIOD_NET_CR_BEQ
columns.description: Period net credit balance. It is specified in the base currency.

columns.name: PERIOD_NET_DR
columns.description: Period net debit balance summarized by itemization process.

columns.name: PERIOD_NET_CR
columns.description: Period net credit balance summarized by itemization process.

columns.name: PERIOD_MONTH
columns.description: Stores the accounting period number.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Natural account type. Valid values are 'A' for 'Asset', 'C' for 'Budgetary (credit)', 'D' for 'Budgetary (debit)','E' for 'Expense', 'L' for 'Liability', 'O' for 'Ownership or Stockholder Equity or Fund Balance' and 'R' for 'Revenue'.
